decision_rule: Each family retains its current candidate role until a separate amendment is explicitly approved. Row, file, directory, technique, and prompt-view counts do not establish independent lineage.

families.metadata_gap: One source file and one host scope provide one verified artifact-level lineage, below the per-family minimum of four.

pros: Removes the clearest pseudoreplication risk.
Can add genuinely independent host or run lineages.
cons: Requires a new license/revision/source gate.
May delay train-family quota recovery.

pros: Preserves scientific independence without payload work.
cons: Reduces active train candidates from four to three, so the train family quota remains failed.

pros: Could test whether source-native session or bounded-time clusters exist.

families.metadata_gap: The archive contains one Linux.log artifact; line or window counts cannot establish four independent lineages.

pros: Adds a development source with explicit run/session provenance.

cons: Requires a new source review and may change transport coverage.

pros: Avoids treating line-level variation as replication.
cons: Reduces active development candidates from two to one, so the development family quota remains failed.

Avoids equating technique-library breadth with experimental replication.
cons: A suitable replacement must preserve literal pointer-recoverable evidence and licensing.

families.metadata_gap: Software test fixtures and parent directories are not independent real captures; repeated blobs and shared fixture generation remain unresolved.

cons: Requires a new source gate and may reduce parser-compatibility coverage.

actions_if_separately_approved: Replace BETH and Loghub with sources that have explicit independent run or capture lineage.
Audit CAM-LDS and SOCBED using bounded, versioned grouping rules.
Replace or demote Atomic and Zeek unless external execution/capture lineage is established.
pros: Strongest scientific independence posture.
Focuses payload effort where metadata makes success plausible.
cons: Largest source-search and source-gate workload.

actions_if_separately_approved: Move weak or unverified candidates to inactive or engineering-only status.
Keep L2 failed or smoke-only until replacement families exist.
pros: Lowest leakage and pseudoreplication risk.
No payload audit needed immediately.
cons: Does not enable baseline, fine-tuning, or a full L2 evaluation.

actions_if_separately_approved: Open a narrowly scoped lineage-only payload audit for CAM-LDS and SOCBED first.
Optionally inspect BETH, Loghub, Atomic, and Zeek only for source-native lineage metadata, without model or label use.
Decide replace versus inactive after audit results are frozen.
pros: Minimizes premature role changes.
Produces direct evidence about grouping feasibility.
cons: Requires new authority and may still end with the same failed Gate.
Payload exposure and review cost are higher.
